# Golden dictionary entries this form's encoding does not reproduce, as
# `<locale> <key>` exactly as the golden dictionary writes the key.
#
# None of them is read by the form: no attribute of the golden form XML holds
# any of these texts. The old engine keyed its dictionary off the structured
# source, so it also emitted
# - the labels of fields a partner fragment replaced (Last name, First name(s),
#   Street, Place, Date, No., Authorized representative(s)): the fragment ships
#   its own dictionary;
# - the plain twin of a text the form writes only as rich text (Weekend/holiday)
#   and the rich twin of one it writes only plain (<p>Signature(s)</p>);
# - Ordering Customer, a source heading the partner fragment replaced.
de fd_&lt;p&gt;Ordering Customer&lt;/p&gt;
de fd_&lt;p&gt;Signature(s)&lt;/p&gt;
de fd_Authorized representative(s)
de fd_Date (dd.mm.yyyy)
de fd_First name(s)
de fd_Last name
de fd_No.
de fd_Ordering Customer
de fd_Place
de fd_Street
de fd_Weekend/holiday
